guidanceConsulted.query: responsive tables horizontal scroll accessibility reference documentation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential heading levels, captioned tables with <th scope>, and keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll regions linked via aria-labelledby.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer>, sequential h1/h2/h3, captioned tables with <th scope>, and focusable .table-wrap containers.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing (max-inline-size), overflow: auto scroll containers instead of overflow: hidden clipping, and flex-wrap with gap for metadata badges.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100% with horizontal scrolling on .compat-table and .scroll-table; .baseline-browsers inherits flex-wrap from /public/styles.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Restrict text-wrap: balance to short headings (h1-h3) and keep code blocks scrollable and legible on narrow mobile screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied via shared /public/styles.css without overriding h1, pre, or code inline.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use root color-scheme and semantic light-dark() tokens rather than hard-coded color literals.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: inherits all color tokens and color-scheme declarations from /public/styles.css.
